text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess,
I should be strong and resilient, yet...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Like this...
I'll never become a princess...!"
choice_data_list: A true "princess" definitely won't give up.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
You would still call me your princess...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! Fufu, that line makes you sound
just like a prince, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Gaaaaah!
Getting all sentimental is totally not my style!
As a princess, I've gotta dig deep and hold my ground!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer!
This princess shall keep her chin up and move forward~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You are quite right. If I am to aim to be a true princess,
I must never give up, keep running, and push beyond!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter what wall stands in our way!
A true princess smashes right through it with her fists and headbutts!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To start, we shall do image training!
Come, Trainer, join me!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Princess Hook! Princess Uppercut!
Princess HEADBUUUUUUTT!!!

After spending about 100 rounds helping her visualize her moves,
Kawakami Princess had completely regained
all of her energy.
